summary: The applicable text is the Fachprüfungsordnung of 25 September 2019 (BA 2019, Mitteilungsblatt 6/2020), in force from winter semester 2020/21. Section 7 requires 66 ECTS of compulsory theory, 12 ECTS of electives from study fields A to D including one 6-ECTS Studienarbeit, 6 ECTS of key competencies, the compulsory introductory studio, introductory project and 30-ECTS practice project, three different elective projects (36 ECTS, at least one Städtebau project and one Stadt- und Regionalentwicklung project), and the 6-ECTS thesis.

categories.name: Elective projects
categories.note: Three different 12-ECTS project modules over the program (36 ECTS), including at least one 'Projekt Städtebau' and one 'Projekt Stadt- und Regionalentwicklung'
